text: The person's skin is red and swollen, and there's a lot of pain. They have a big mark on their arm.

speaker: self
text: हे मी ते आहे. मल्याची दिमागी दराणे झपत आहे. त्याने पोत बरले. जुन्ही नम्बर आहे?

text: My brother got really badly hurt! His arm is all red and swollen, and it hurts really bad. Can you send an ambulance quickly?

text: Person nihalya chya bhosli bhosli... aale... kal ni kafa chya kafali nahi bhosli... ane... aale... madhkar aale... nahi chya...

text: The person is not breathing, I think. I'm scared. His face went blue. Oh no, I need help. Can someone come quick?

text: Ma'am, aaple patrle heart pain aauche, tya chya thappad akkhe tak tak aat.acha. Amchi ambulance nikalna chahe.

text: Ma'am, my aunt, she fainted just now. Doctor nahi aaya. Hospital bhi nahi.

text: Ma'am, please help! This person's face is crooked, and they can't move their arm! What should I do? Can you tell me what to do?

text: महाराष्ट्र में किसी लोगों का बोझ बढ़ गया है। उनके मुंह से खून रूह रहा है। मंडाव मोहाली क्षेत्र में।

text: Ma'am, help! There's a guy lying on the ground, he's not breathing and his chest is going up and down really fast! Please send an ambulance, he needs help now!

speaker: bystander
text: Ma'am, this is really bad! There's bleeding and the lady is not breathing properly. We need an ambulance right now! Please, hurry up!

text: I took too many tablets by mistake, and I'm feeling really dizzy and sick to my stomach. I need help.

text: आणि ते आणखी दुर्बल झाले! त्याला जलाचा आहे आणि तो निराकार झाले!

text: Ma'am, my grandma suddenly can't speak properly and her face is crooked. Can you please send the ambulance fast?

text: Ma'am, I... feeling... not good... stomach pain... started... few hours ago... Doctor said... maybe... gas... but... doesn't... stop... now... really... dizzy... head... need... help... hospital...

text: दूर से आने वाली गाड़ी में एक लड़की का दिखाई दे रहा है, उसका गायक नाड़ी और ठंडी हो रही है, उसका रक्त बह रहा है, जीना चाहिए!

speaker: relative
text: Ma'am, aadhaa gaadi mein ghaala, aaj kal mein, hamesha pain, ho rahi hai, bahut bahut pain, lega lega, hands mein bhi, mazaak nahi hai, doctor aagaya, please hurry.

speaker: self
text: Ma'am, my chest feels really tight and I'm finding it hard to breathe. It's not going away, you know? Can you please send the ambulance fast?

speaker: self
text: मी एकाच्या भागात आहे, नंतर दुर्बाल झाले आहे, र माझा जाहिराती बावडा झाली! मला आमचे बावडे आणि जाहिराती देअले जाईल!

speaker: self
text: दम लग रहा है! लग रहा है! मेरे रोगी ने बहुत गहरे और कम गहरे डाबे-दागे फेंके हैं। लगता है उनके मोटर्स खराब हुए हैं। आपकी मदद कैसे कर सकते हैं?

text: Ma'am, it's bad! This person's chest is hurting really bad, and they're not breathing right! Can you send an ambulance quick? It's really serious!

text: माझी बेटी हलव्यात आहे, तिची जाब दुरुस्त झाली. तिच्या आय चाल बेरुकडे गेली आहे. मला चिकित्सक वाटण्यात आहे.

text: जीवन की खूब बुरी स्थिति में है, दाहिनी बैरिस्टर दर्द लग रहा है। रक्तचाप बढ़ गया है।

speaker: self
text: माँ पीड़ित है, लड़की कहाँ जाए लाई? फॉक्स रियल्स में? नहीं लाई, आज भी दर्द आरंभ हुआ? फिर भी नहीं, फिर भी दर्द बढ़ गई? इंडिया फार्म्स ने दवाएं दीं, लेकिन फैसला नहीं आर्हा?

speaker: bystander
text: मायूंच्या इतक्यात दुर्जन येते. त्याच्या कल्पात बावडी येते आणि रक्त रसायनीस्तात वाघवते. मला मदत करा, कृपया.

speaker: self
text: मी एक नावात झाले आहे आणि माझी नाभी वेळकडे रॅकल झाली आहे. नाथाल्याला लग्यात आहे. माझी आंठी पिकल्यात आहे.

text: Ma'am, my uncle, he's not breathing properly. I don't know what's happening, he's just lying on the floor. Please come quick, he's turning blue.

text: Ma'am, my brother got scalded with hot water. It's on his hand and it's really red and swollen. Please send the ambulance soon.

text: Ma'am, I fell from the bike, leg hurts really bad, can't walk. Doctor please, what should I do? My leg... swelling up... hospital...

text: Aaple friend... very confused... face... not moving properly... arm... also not responding...说话不通...脑袋晕...说话困难...帮助...快点来...

text: I drank some medicine by mistake and I'm feeling really dizzy and my stomach hurts a lot.

text: Ma'am, aag haichi... [trailing off] ...hand... very painful... water not helping... [pauses] ...skin coming off... [hysterical] help... please... [sobs]

text: I think I'm having chest pain, it's really bad. My heart feels funny, like it's pounding. Uh, it came on suddenly, and it won't go away.

text: दूध खाये तो नहीं पड़ा, आज से तीन दिन बाद महाराष्ट्र में... बुखार लगा रहा है, गले में डर आ रहा है... राहुल कहाँ गया, माँ को भी दरवाजा खुला नहीं... मेहनदार आएं कृपया...

text: The kid fell and hit his head. He's crying a lot and won't stop. Let me know if you need me to do anything.
